body: Pre-candidate review of exact 64230e7d62bc99e26bb553bd354f37fde2b4e5b9: clean isolated npm verify passes; exact SHA and corrected blob/tree links render; DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION=forty-zeroes fails closed. One blocker remains. In a disposable exact clone I changed only the tracked getting-started title to MUTATED WITHOUT COMMIT. npm build still exited 0. The rendered site says Generated from 64230e7d62bc and links it, while warning that the page corresponds to no commit; the mutated page still emits Confirmed / Directly inspectable at the cited source revision evidence links. Thus dirty=true remains internally contradictory and sourceVerified/sourceRevision/sourceLink still authorize HEAD as the built identity even when HEAD is known not to describe the bytes. Repair condition: for dirty trees either fail the build, or make the source identity unverified and suppress/relabel exact-revision evidence links; add this tracked-mutation court. This is infrastructure-only evidence and does not relax the separate owner content gate.
